intended_object: The length of an R-module M: the supremum of lengths of strict chains of submodules (equal to the length of a composition series, or ∞ if none exists). Inferred from the docstring and name.
explanation: Order.krullDim (Submodule R M) is the supremum of the lengths of LTSeries (strict chains) in the submodule lattice, which is the standard definition of module length. Any maximal chain can be extended to run from ⊥ to ⊤, so this agrees with the supremum over chains from 0 to M. The submodule lattice is never empty, so the krullDim is never ⊥ and unbot is well defined. Edge cases are correct: the zero module has length 0, a simple module has length 1, and a module of infinite length gets ⊤ in ℕ∞. Rings and modules over them are the standard setting for this notion.
